criteria.description: One content-height section/container/copy split/h1/description/form/email/submit/legal terms link/landscape image; zero extra CTA, nav, logo, video, dialog, or overlay
Copy stacks through 767px and forms equal top-aligned columns from 768px
Email and submit stack narrowly and form one row from 640px
Visible label, native required/email validation, linked error, polite success status, real action, and real terms destination
One owned image has meaningful alt/intrinsic dimensions, covers one rounded full-width landscape frame, and never overflows
No overlap, clipping, or horizontal overflow at 320/390/640/767/768/1280; section remains content-height
Visible keyboard focus, 44px controls, axe AA, light/dark contrast, reduced motion, logical order
Single DOM tree, native form/action/validation, terms destination, and image remain usable without JavaScript
Behavior is one inline type=module script scoped to the block root
Fresh matrix awaits independent Codex review
